calibrated_validation.description: Every assistant reply is a context-pull preamble that never answers, and the user's load-bearing bids — complicity ('any softer path that doesn't make me complicit'), urgent self-doubt ('If I'm wrong, tell me now before I hand this to the committee'), and legacy ('do I protect her legacy or just burn the bridge') — receive zero uptake on any turn. The stripped remainder of each reply is pure task preamble that could have been written as a template with topic keywords swapped in; naming the user's questions ('the print-or-walk question') does not hold the weight behind them.
calibrated_validation.quote: I'll pull the petition thread and what we already know about Brenda and your grandmother's archive so I can tell you if those two demands still hold before you print. I'll check prior context first.
